newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks seen regaining some lost ground.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks seen regaining some lost ground.

text.p: SPI Sycom cl 2372 +16 US 30yr cl 7.17 steady
10yrbond futs cl 92.000 +0.055 Gold NY 346.25 Lon fix 346.75
*Stocks seen set to move up after Dow bounces. "We didn't do too badly yesterday. We should pick up a few points today after New York improved," said a dealer at a Sydney brokerage.
*U.S. blue chips staged their strongest rally in three weeks, propelled by better than expected earnings reports.
*ADRs: News Corp 17-7/8 (steady), BHP 26-1/8 (+1/8), WMC 24-1/4 (-3/8), National Australia Bank 62 (-5/8)
*Gold price was lower. On LME, base metals prices climbed away from earlier lows, although activity remained low-key and movements took place in thin conditions.
